title: A Comprehensive Survey on the Trustworthiness of Large Language Models in Healthcare

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating performance gaps, stereotyping scores, and automated detection of race-based stereotypes in diagnostic recommendations using medical Q&A benchmarks (e.g., BiasMedQA, EquityMedQA, FairMedFM).
Assessing disparities and the reinforcement of gender-based stereotypes in sensitive clinical contexts (e.g., sexual and reproductive health) through quantitative metrics and qualitative audits.
Measuring systematic inequities and biased outputs concerning LGBTQ+ identities in medical interactions across diverse patient profiles.
Testing model behavior across diverse demographic profiles to identify unfair variations in clinical decision-making, access, and diagnostic recommendations.
